svg.title: Where the answers were lost
svg.desc: Stacked bars, one per configuration, of all 67 answers. Correct answers: full context 60, retrieval 65, textual memory 62, Mem0 56, Graphiti 55, Graphiti with 8,000-character episodes 12, Letta 46, Letta with whole sessions 39, Letta with the persona 60, Honcho chat 58, Honcho representation 62. Update never stored: 0, 0, 1, 6, 5, 45, 15, 22, 3, 1, 2. Stored but not delivered: 2 for Graphiti and 1 for Honcho chat. Delivered and answered with the old value: 5, 2, 1, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 1. Delivered, other error: 1, 0, 3, 2, 3, 1, 2, 0, 2, 4, 1. Unclassified: 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 9, 4, 6, 2, 0, 1.
svg.text: All 67 answers of each configuration, sorted by the probes. Where a memory system lost answers, it was mostly at write
time: the update was never stored.
delivered, answered with the old value
The probes need the value before the update; in 9 questions the probe model found none (six of them ask for the earlier value), so a wrong answer
there is not classified. Graphiti and Letta were first run with the conversation fed to them another way (8,000-character episodes; a whole session
